request.spec:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The consolidated figures now show, for each grade, the due-totals of the people on that grade added up over the whole tree, and for each status, how many claims across the tree are in it. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

This was a front-end change only; no stored data or server endpoints changed.

- **`src/main/frontend/features/rates/due.slot.tsx`**: a new `useGradeDueTotals(sheetId)` works out one sheet's due-total for each grade. It counts the people on that grade as of the sheet's today, leaves out retired people and skips n/a. These are the same figures that sheet's own summary shows.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/consolidated/consolidated.slot.tsx`**: the code that adds up each sheet's figures in turn now also adds these grade totals, and counts each sheet's claims by status. It shows them as `consolidated-grade-<A|B|C>-due-total` and `consolidated-status-<DRAFT|OPEN|PENDING|SETTLED|VOID|REVIEW>-count`.

Each grade's tree-wide total is a straight sum of every person's due-total. The tree's overall due-total, which already existed, trims the highest and lowest figure on each sheet. So the grade totals can add up to more than the overall due-total, and that is expected, not a bug.
